/--
Adds two bitvectors. This can be interpreted as either signed or unsigned addition modulo `2^n`.
Usually accessed via the `+` operator.

SMT-LIB name: `bvadd`.
-/
@[expose]
protected def add (x y : BitVec n) : BitVec n := .ofNat n (x.toNat + y.toNat)
